prose.name: Hunt: Escaped Test Subjects on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A science facility on <Planet> has lost its test subjects, and the slate got off the planet before the news did. They are loose at the <Place> and nobody left there is going to handle it. I need to fly out and put them down.
